Merchant dietary labels in names/options are factual labels, not independent ingredient certification.

The linked ordering catalogue differs and is recorded separately; no price is transferred between channels. Five visually inspected lunch/student posters all include drinks and are excluded. Website content has no menu effective date and includes some historical labels; current stock/availability is not inferred. Ingredient health cards and beverages are omitted.
